logp.method_description: Partition coefficients of 1, 3, 5, and cisplatin in n-octanol/water were determined by the classical shake flask method using the standard protocol [66]. Two parallel experiments were performed for each sample and the amount of the complexes in the n-octanol phase was analyzed by UV-vis spectrophotometry. Partition coefficient (log P) defined as the logarithmic ratio of the equilibrium concentrations of the dissolved complex between the organic and aqueous phases (log CO/CW) was estimated.
